description: Unit tests for authentication hashing utilities, including v1/v2 migration, tenant orgSalt management, and verification procedures.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieve the pepper string used in hashing, from environment variables.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Generate legacy v1 static salted hash of a password.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hash password using v2 scheme incorporating tenant orgSalt and optional pepper.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verify a password against a hashed password, considering hashing version and tenant info.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensure tenant document has a generated orgSalt; generate and save if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Wrapper function that defaults to v2 hashing incorporating tenant info.

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verify password, migrate legacy hashes to current version if needed.
